answer: Sybil defense via a frozen stake per identity: opening an agent account requires collateral sized to the influence it requests, and that bond is slashed once one operator is shown controlling several accounts. A farm spreading weight over aliases must post a bond for each, so cost scales linearly with accounts minted. The registry is an atlas of bonds, mapping backer and unlock height, so shared funding paths surface instead of hiding. Reputation adds weight only where payments are verifiable, keeping counts ivory-clean, and each record is a prism splitting one operator into visible slices.
